name: @cartpie/mcp

tools.name: extract_product
tools.description: Given a retailer product URL, return clean normalized product data (title, price, currency, availability, variants, GTIN, brand, …) as compact JSON. Use this whenever a user pastes a product link or you need structured details for a single item. Costs credits only on a successful, non-cached extraction (cache hits and failures are free); the exact charge is in meta.credits and surfaced as `credits`. See get_pricing for the credit table.

freshness.description: Max cache age before re-extracting, e.g. "6h", "30m", "0".

tools.name: extract_products
tools.description: Extract normalized product data for several retailer URLs at once (up to 20). Returns one result per URL with its data, meta, and credits — or an error. The batch's total cost is the sum of each URL's credits; cache hits and failures are free. Use this to compare a handful of links in a single step.

tools.name: find_offers
tools.description: Given a product GTIN/EAN/UPC, find the same product across retailers Cartpie has seen, cheapest first. Use this to answer 'find this cheaper elsewhere'.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Return the current billing-period credit usage for the configured API key: plan, included_credits, credits_used, credits_remaining, overage_enabled, a usage breakdown (credits/billable/cached/render/failed), and rate_limit_per_minute. Use it to check how many credits are left before a large batch.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Return Cartpie's public credit pricing table. Credits are charged by HOW a page was served — the cheapest path that succeeds — NOT per retailer, so the same URL can cost different amounts on different requests. Cache hits and failed extractions are free. Use this to explain or estimate cost. Works without an API key.
